title: A Novel Three-Step Technique for the Simple, Safe, and Efficient Complete Removal of Idiopathic Epiretinal Membrane

license.statement: CC BY-NC 3.0 (unported) incorporated in Dove Medical Press terms (article <license>); non-commercial, PRIVATE

condition: Idiopathic macular epiretinal membrane (grade 2 crinkled cellophane maculopathy or grade 3 macular pucker; secondary ERM excluded); retrospective single-surgeon series (Shanghai Tong Ren Hospital), 55 eyes of 55 patients operated November 2021 to October 2022, all followed for 12 months

groups.agent: 23-gauge pars plana vitrectomy with triamcinolone-assisted posterior hyaloid separation, ICG-stained ILM-guided ERM flap, wide-margin arc with a curved DSP scraper and extensive full-block peeling, ICG re-staining
groups.description: Single arm evaluating the novel three-step ERM removal technique (declared experimental technique)

series.notes: Mean ± SD (table footnote); times count from surgery (1, 6 and 12 months postoperatively); all 55 patients reported followed for 12 months; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: Table 1 vitreoretinal condition counts (vitreous haemorrhage, RD, iatrogenic MH, recurrence)

exclusions.reason: ranges are not admissible; means duplicate Table 1
single illustrative case in a figure

notes: Time origin: the vitrectomy with membrane peeling (preoperative visit = month 0)
OCT device and CMT definition are not stated (measure central_unspecified, device unstated); prior treatment of the ERM eyes is not stated ('primary idiopathic ERM' denotes non-secondary ERM)
